research.name: OPENRNDR
research.note: Kotlin creative coding framework where GLSL shade style snippets restyle any drawn primitive, with contour and shape geometry tools.
research.license: BSD-2-Clause (FreeBSD variant with the views-and-conclusions disclaimer, i.e. BSD-2-Clause-Views)

effects: shade styles: GLSL fragment and vertex snippets injected into the drawer's templated shaders to restyle fill and stroke
compound builder for boolean union, difference and intersection of 2D shapes
contour offsetting and rectified contours for evenly spaced motion along curves
filter post-processing applied to color buffers
